datasets.title: Chad Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Chad Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/chad_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2021 and spatially mapped to geographic units in Chad. The classifications represent standardized assessments of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards such as drought, conflict, and economic shocks.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity phases across geographic areas in Chad.
